programme.title: The Ship Sinkers
programme.desc: What fate awaits ships that were once proud vessels at bay, but have now turned into floating junkyards? While one option is to cut them up for scrap, another alternative is to use them to bolster marine biodiversity by turning them into artificial reefs. The old naval ships are sunk to an underwater resting place by ship sinkers.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Lost in Space"
programme.desc: There have been a few occasions when spacecraft have been lost in space. Host Emily Calandrelli looks at several of these adventures.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Hidden Nature"
programme.desc: In this episode, we see a few hidden parts of nature.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Research in Remote Locations"
programme.desc: In this episode, we visit a few remote areas to see how research and restoration is conducted.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Science Communicators"
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll meet a few different science communicators

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Crashes"
programme.desc: Join us as we investigate the worst plane, train and ship disasters of all time.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Man Made Disasters"
programme.desc: Explore with us how a manmade disaster could be as much destructive as some natural disaster.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Just Like Downtown"
programme.desc: Dave deals with a messy train, J.P. takes down a tree, Regional Crane lifts a huge wall, and Maxum Crane moves a couch to a high-rise.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Taking out the Trash"
programme.desc: Dave faces a tricky residential lift, J.P. races between last-minute jobs, and Brad and Nathan Moore help a family’s dream come true.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Bridging the Gap"
programme.desc: Nathan battles strong winds on a big roofing job, Dave handles an easy lift, J.P. moves a hot tub, and Dan faces confusion on a bridge build.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Special Delivery"
programme.desc: Regional Crane’s new machine hits a hydraulic snag. Dave uses his downtime for repairs, and Brad helps clear a stand of pine trees.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "A Taste of Life Part 2"
programme.desc: Learn about the foods and the culture that makes Sardinia so special. From fishing with their hands, to traditional foods... it's a culinary exploration in good health.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Adaptation"
programme.desc: Travel to La Paz, Bolivia, to see how high altitude impacts the body. From science to tradition, visit the witches market and learn about an ancient Inca medicine for altitude sickness

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Superfoods"
programme.desc: The high altitude environment makes foods that are considered "super". From quinoa, to special beans and salt - We travel from the Uyuni Salt flats back to La Paz to work with a Master Chef.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Message From Space?"
programme.desc: Deep in the mountains of West Virginia, the Green Bank Observatory has been receiving a mysterious signal from deep space. Could this be message from an advanced civilization, or is it a much stranger and violent occurrence?

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Racing Crashes"
programme.desc: Explore the high tech, high-speed world of car and bike racing.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Trains"
programme.desc: A fascinating look at the radical concepts and innovative ideas that are making trains faster, safer and ever more futuristic.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Strike Planes"
programme.desc: Take a look at the history of creating stronger, faster and more powerful military aircraft.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Combat Helicopters"
programme.desc: Ultimate Combat Helicopters offers a fascinating perspective on the technology used to create today’s most powerful combat helicopters.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Black Holes"
programme.desc: Stripping away cosmic layers with CGI, this film reveals how black holes act as both destructive abysses and vital anchors for our galaxy.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Comets"
programme.desc: Peeling back the dusty coma via CGI, this film explores if icy comets brought water and life to Earth while tracking the threats they pose.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Mars"
programme.desc: Beneath the red dust, CGI peels away Martian volcanoes and ice to reveal a once-Earth-like world and the challenges of future human missions.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "The Sun"
programme.desc: By stripping away the Sun's boiling plasma layers, this CGI study reveals the nuclear core that fuels our world while tracking lethal solar storms.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "Nightmare on Hollywood Weapons"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry get to test several scenes from Horror films! Terry wants to find out what is the best way to kill a Zombie, just in case he ever ends up in a Zombie Apocalypse, and they will test a scene from the horror classic, Freddie vs. Jason!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "All for One!"
programme.desc: Terry travels back in time to see if he can make it as a Three Musketeer! Can he throw his sword and kill the enemy? Can the cross that he wears around his neck stop a bullet? Can a lead ball ignite from a black powder ignite a carriage full of black powder and brandy? Terry enlists the help of his companions to find out!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "RED-ish"
programme.desc: Terry takes himself out of “retirement” to test some scenes from RED that will be extremely dangerous. One of which Larry will take great joy in because he gets to fire an RPG at Terry to see if he can shoot it out of the air, and Terry gets to play with a mini-gun again to see if he can cut a van in half!!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "MacSchappert"
programme.desc: What can Terry do with just a paperclip? Probably nothing, but Larry and Terry will test several scenes from MacGyver, including making an exploding pen, shooting a spear out of a telescope, and they will enlist the help of Andre Ellingson’s Special Effects team to see if they can turn a car muffler into a bazooka!

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Hyperloop"
programme.desc: Virgin Hyperloop is a train that runs inside a steel tunnel. This revolutionary new vehicle floats along the track using magnetic levitation and glides at airline speeds.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "The Race to Space"
programme.desc: A new era of space, where small satellites no bigger than a showbox will be deployed not in one or twos, but in their thousands, referred to as satellite swarms.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Perpetual Power"
programme.desc: All over the world, engineers and scientists are racing to solve one key problem: how to safely and efficiently store electricity at a huge scale but at a low cost.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Timber Skyscraper"
programme.desc: This film explores the mind-blowing world of timber buildings for a more sustainable future.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Skateboards, Vacuum Cleaners and ATMs"
programme.desc: Skateboard, vacuum cleaner, ATM, car jack, digital projector, and multi-tool... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Canadian Space Agency"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli visits the Canadian Space Center in Quebec, and examines their exceptional expertise in robotics, which includes the famous Canadarm.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Fun with the Sun"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at NASA’s next mission to send a spacecraft that will “touch” the sun.
